what it does: liveness check
auth: none

what it does: turn signed messages into api keys — one key per account
auth: none — the signed message IS the proof

what it does: which account does this api key belong to
auth: x-api-key header — the legacy x-session-token is the fallback and x-api-key wins

what it does: give an account a NEW api key — the old one dies at once
auth: none — the signed message IS the proof

what it does: queue a BATCH of transactions
auth: x-api-key header — the key names the account the batch is queued for
the errors: 400 no_transactions | 400 too_many_transactions (over 50) | 400 no_contract_id | 400 no_method | 400 args_not_an_object | 400 account_not_named_by_agent | 401 no_api_key | 401 unknown_api_key | 500 db_unavailable | 500 args_broken

what it does: the filterable queue list — pages with a cursor and filters by many accounts and contracts
auth: none — the list is open; the key is only used for the reader's own hide_sent filter
success: 200 { items: [ one batch each ], total, nextCursor } — nextCursor is the cursor of the next page or null when the page is the last one; total is the count of the WHOLE match before the limit

what it does: the contracts and the accounts that have queued work — what the feed's filter bar offers its buttons from
auth: none — the route is OPEN
success: 200 { contracts: [ { contractId, count } ], accounts: [ { accountId, count } ] }

what it does: one queued batch with its transactions and its accounts
auth: x-api-key header

what it does: add YOUR OWN account to a queued batch
auth: x-api-key header — the key must belong to body.accountId
the errors: 403 not_your_account | 404 no_such_queue | 409 already_on_the_queue | 401 no_api_key | 401 unknown_api_key | 500 db_unavailable | 500 args_broken

what it does: remove YOUR OWN account from a queued batch
auth: x-api-key header — the key must belong to the account in the path
the errors: 403 not_your_account | 404 no_such_queue | 404 not_on_the_queue | 401 no_api_key | 401 unknown_api_key | 500 db_unavailable | 500 args_broken
